NORTHERN PROVINCE PROVINCIAL COUNCIL
LOCAL AUTHORITIES (STANDARD BY-LAWS) ACT, No. 6 OF 1952
Approved Standard By Laws for Local Authorities in Northern Province

Standard Draft By-Laws Chapter I to VI made by me, C. V. Wigneswaran, as Chief Minister and the Minister of Finance andPlanning, Law and Order, Land, Social Service, Rehabilitation, Women's Affairs, Electricity, Housing and Construction,Industries and Enterprise Promotion, Tourism, Local Government and Provincial Administration of Northern ProvinceProvincial Council by virtue of powers vested in the Minister under whose purview the subject of Local Government ofProvincial Council fall under the Sub section I of Section 2 of Local Authorities (Standard By-Laws) Act, No. 6 of 1952read with paragraph (a) of Sub section 1 of Section 2 of Provincial Council (Consequential Provisions) Act, No. 12 of1989 are published hereby.
1. Standard By Laws of Municipal Councils in the Northern Province the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1952/14 of
2. Standard By Laws of Urban Councils in the Northern Province the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1952/15 of

It is hereby published that the above Standard By Laws for Municipal Councils, Urban Councils and Pradeshiya Sabhas inthe Northern Province has been submitted at the Northern Provincial Council and was approved by the Northern ProvincialCouncil on 21.02.2017.
